title: Independent witnesses to the log's head: monotonic, linked, verified against a trust root
note: Assurance E (D-2026-170). Each mutation deletes one rule of the witness (rollback, fork, the proof's hashing, numbering, length, linking and end, persist-before-answer, no trust on first use, provisioning) or of the verifier (signatures, origin, truncation, fork, quorum, distinct witnesses, staleness, the trust root's log, the signed time). tests/test_witness.py holds each with a control.

mutations.name: WT1_a_witness_rolls_back
mutations.rationale: Assurance E (D-2026-170): a witness cosigns a head below one it cosigned

mutations.name: WT2_a_witness_cosigns_two_heads_at_one_position
mutations.rationale: Assurance E (D-2026-170): a witness cosigns a fork at a position it already cosigned

mutations.name: WT3_records_need_not_link
mutations.rationale: Assurance E (D-2026-170): a rewritten history is cosigned as an extension

mutations.name: WT4_records_need_not_hash
mutations.rationale: Assurance E (D-2026-170): an altered record is accepted in a proof

mutations.name: WT5_records_need_not_be_numbered
mutations.rationale: Assurance E (D-2026-170): a misnumbered or reordered proof is accepted

mutations.name: WT7_the_records_need_not_reach_the_head
mutations.rationale: Assurance E (D-2026-170): a witness cosigns a head the records do not reach

mutations.name: WT8_a_witness_forgets_what_it_cosigned
mutations.rationale: Assurance E (D-2026-170): a witness cosigns and keeps no record of it

mutations.name: WT9_a_witness_answers_before_it_remembers

mutations.name: WT10_a_witness_trusts_on_first_use
mutations.rationale: Assurance E (D-2026-170): a witness that lost its state accepts whatever it is shown next

mutations.name: WT11_a_witness_is_provisioned_twice
mutations.rationale: Assurance E (D-2026-170): re-provisioning silently resets what a witness cosigned

mutations.name: WT13_signatures_are_not_checked
mutations.rationale: Assurance E (D-2026-170): a forged, moved or retimed cosignature counts

mutations.name: WT14_another_log_s_cosignature_counts
mutations.rationale: Assurance E (D-2026-170): a cosignature of another log vouches for this one

mutations.name: WT15_truncation_is_a_note

mutations.name: WT16_a_fork_is_a_note

mutations.name: WT17_one_witness_is_a_quorum

mutations.name: WT18_one_witness_counts_twice
mutations.rationale: Assurance E (D-2026-170): one witness's two cosignatures make a quorum of two
